name: Seats
text: Adds passenger seats (light: 1 extra; large and helicopter: up to 3 extra). Age VI.

name: Floaty bedding
text: Plane floats on water: +0.04 blocks/tick^2 lift while the hull is in water, so it takes off from a lake (0.8 m/s^2). Age VI.

name: Armor
text: Armour plating: incoming damage x (1 - 0.04 x armour value of the fitted armour item). Age VI.

name: Shooter
text: Fires arrows, fire charges or firework rockets from the nose (one item per shot, inventory slot of 1 stack). Age VI.

name: Healing
text: One-shot repair kit: restores 1 hit point in flight, 2 on the ground, up to 2x max health; consumed on use. Age VII.

name: Folding
text: Folds the wings so the plane fits a hangar bay or a ship deck. Age VII.

name: Furnace engine
text: Burns any furnace fuel in slot 1. Burn ticks drain at the airframe fuel cost per tick, so one coal (1600 ticks) lasts 26 s on a light plane and 13 s on a helicopter. Age VI.

name: Liquid engine
text: Burns liquid fuel from a 4000 L internal tank (fuel values per litre come from the plane_liquid_fuels data folder); fills from buckets and fluid-item containers. Age VII.

name: Electric engine
text: 1.5 MJ battery; draws 12 J per tick of fuel cost while throttled: 720 W light, 1440 W large, 2400 W cargo, 1440 W helicopter. Age VII.

name: Solar panel
text: Trickle charge for the electric engine in daylight with sky access: up to 100 W on a light plane, 200 W on a large or cargo plane, scaled by sun and cut by rain and thunder. Helicopters cannot fit it. Age VII.

name: Booster
text: Raises the throttle ceiling from 5 to 10 steps for short bursts. Age VII.

name: Banner
text: Mounts a banner on the tail. Age VI.

name: Payload
text: Carries one payload crate that can be dropped over a target; allowed payloads come from the plane_payload data folder. Age VI.

name: Chest
text: Adds a chest inventory. Age VI.

name: Supply crate
text: A barrel on a parachute that can be released from the air. Age VI.

name: Jukebox
text: Plays a disc for everyone in range while flying. Age VII.

name: Light helicopter
text: Two-seat to four-seat light helicopter with the same upgrade slots as a large plane (no solar panel). Jump climbs, forward tilts and moves, no key hovers. Age VII.
